title: Sharpness of the Cyclic Integral Floer Bound Below the Stable Morse Number
summary: We construct a simply connected closed Kähler manifold of real dimension 3332 and minimal Chern number one whose Hamiltonian fixed-point count attains the cyclic integral Floer bound while falling below the stable Morse number. The Hamiltonian diffeomorphism has exactly $`1\,872\,232`$ fixed points, all nondegenerate and with contractible orbit loops, whereas the stable Morse number is $`1\,872\,264`$. Thus the stronger stable Morse bound fails by exactly 32, even when the cyclic integral bound is sharp.
family_title: Counterexamples to stable-Morse and strong Arnold fixed-point bounds

review.reason: Constructs a Kähler manifold example showing a Floer fixed-point bound is sharp.
